name: Unluckies
source:
An incomplete mlm visual novel I made with four different love interests. It is currently not complete and is a demo with possible errors and issues.

[from [url=https://cheesychilaquil.itch.io/unluckies-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我做的一部尚未完成的男男戀愛視覺小說，有四個不同的可攻略對象。目前釋出的只是未完成的試玩版，可能還會遇到錯誤和其他問題。

［摘自[url=https://cheesychilaquil.itch.io/unluckies-demo]itch.io[/url]］
